### 🟡 Changes recommended The ingress port behavior changed without updating the README, leaving documented defaults and HTTPS/TLS guidance inaccurate for custom service ports.
1 open issue - [Update ingress path port documentation for custom service ports](https://github.com/portainer/k8s/pull/231#discussion_r4594006020) · New
What changed in this PR Updates the Portainer Helm chart so Ingress backends use the configured Service HTTP/HTTPS ports instead of hard-coded defaults while preserving explicit per-path port overrides. **Changes:** - Uses `service.httpPort` and `service.httpsPort` as fallback ports for both modern and legacy Ingress API variants. - Adds template-test coverage for custom HTTP and HTTPS ports across both API variants. - Bumps the chart patch version to `245.3.2`. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | charts/​portainer/​templates/​ingress.yaml | Routes Ingress backends to the configured Service ports for both Ingress API variants while retaining explicit path port overrides. | | charts/​portainer/​Chart.yaml | Increments the chart patch version to `245.3.2`. | | .ci/​scripts/​template-tests.sh | Adds regression checks for custom HTTP and HTTPS service ports across both Ingress API variants. |
Review effort: Lite

review_comments.body: This changes the documented/default behavior for `ingress.hosts.paths.port`, but `charts/portainer/README.md:80` still says the default is `9000` (and does not explain the HTTPS/TLS case). Users relying on the chart reference will get incorrect guidance for custom `service.httpPort`/`service.httpsPort`; update the ingress port documentation alongside this change.
